question: Malaria is a deadly disease caused by parasites that are transmitted to people through the bite of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Anopheles mosquito__****__​__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anopheles mosquitoes Adult Females prefer to feed on humans or animals like Cattles. **
 
• **The female mosquitoes **travel in the** swarms to mate with some Anopheles male mosquitoes which often occur at dusk.****** ****
 
• Following a **blood meal**, **female mosquitoes** rest for a few days as the** blood breaks down and the eggs hatch.**
 
• With the** exception of Antarctica**, **Anopheles mosquitoes** are** present almost everywhere**.
 
• **Anopheles mosquitoes** spread the** parasite disease malaria.**
 
• **Malaria is a parasitic infection transmitted by Anopheline mosquitoes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **When fresh or stagnant water is present Adult female mosquitoes lay eggs on the surface **

 
 
• There are many different places where you can find water, such as puddles, creeks, ditches, ornamental ponds, horse troughs ,unmaintained swimming pools and marshy areas.
 
• **Single eggs** are laid by female **Culex mosquito.**
 
 
 
• **Aedes **aegypti is a recognised carrier of a number of viruses such as the chikungunya, dengue and zika viruses.There are yearly reports of imported cases in Europe.
 
• **Flea bites leave an itchy welt on the skin, often on the ankles and legs. **
